chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: Buddies with Lester Young on the road
summary: He and Lester roomed in the same houses on the road because hotels were closed to them.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: So you and Lester got together a few times.

Yeah, we was kind of like buddies on the road, you know. We was kind of like buddies on the road. You know, you couldn't get into hotels down South and things, where we'd go. So you had to go rooming houses. And he and I would always get a room in the same house. That's the way it was, I guess. It made us be buddies, you know. We'd get into the house and order up some...order up a juice... We'd try to get a place where they sold juice at,
you know. And we had a ball. We really did have a ball.
